The passages do not describe a proposal specifically targeting demeaning or intimidating messages. They do propose a **general safety mechanism**: use a weaker, more trusted language model to select each output token from an untrusted model’s suggestions, providing a human-readable explanation for every selection. (https://www.lesswrong.com/posts/5ZFgZbqp6Mi2xpYjK/an-explanation-for-every-token-using-an-llm-to-sample)

The proposed mechanism is to **limit manipulation and improve oversight**: the untrusted model supplies only single-token hints rather than generating whole messages directly, while the trusted model’s explanations make its choices easier to check. These safety benefits are presented as hypotheses, not demonstrated protection against harassment. (https://www.lesswrong.com/posts/5ZFgZbqp6Mi2xpYjK/an-explanation-for-every-token-using-an-llm-to-sample)
